messages:
noah: Quick follow-up after yesterday's outage: policy picked a cheaper regional variant and p99 spiked. Can we agree a minimal "signal-mapper" plan so runtimes don't have to change all at once?

maya: TL;DR: runtime owners won't be able to ship new fields immediately. Suggest a compiler-side mapper (shim) that normalizes whatever we get into canonical fields: runtime.capacity_score, runtime.p99_probe_ms, runtime.signal_ts.

sam: Agreed. Shim should also implement staleness aging. If signal_ts > 12s then decay capacity_score toward 0.25. Keeps policy conservative for stale probes.

eli: Addability: the shim must be versioned per-runtime and include a small test vector so runtime owners can confirm mappings. Also emit a shim.mapping_version tag to telemetry.

tess: UX ask: Console needs a lightweight preview showing normalized fields + the raw payload for a chosen request window. Helps runtime owners validate mapper correctness.

noah: Policy sketch: prefer same-region if capacity_score>=0.6 and p99_probe_ms<=300; else if capacity_score>=0.4 and cost_delta<=0.15 allow cost pick; otherwise hedge N=1 preferring latency with cost_cap=0.3. Hedging opt-in per-tenant by default during rollout.

maya: Tests: sim three patterns: stale-probe, sudden p99 spike, and rapid cost-churn. Collect metrics: request p99, hedge_count, egress bytes delta.

sam: Backcompat defaults for missing fields: capacity_score=0.33, p99_probe_ms=9999, signal_ts=now-60s. Document in SDK.

eli: Ops: create alerts for region.capacity_score_drop (30% drop, 1m) and routing.hedge_rate_spike. Also log shim.mapping_version so we can track runtime adoption.

ops-bot: @eli created alert: "region.capacity_score_drop" threshold=30% window=60s. Runbook linked.

noah: Action items:
- eli: publish shim mapping table + small JSON test vectors (ETA: Wed)
- sam: add unit tests + sim job (ETA: Thu)
- maya: RFC follow-up with rollout notes (ETA: Tue)
- tess: console preview mock (ETA: Mon)

noah: If no objections I'll merge the follow-up and start a staged rollout with per-tenant opt-in.

sam: +1

maya: +1
